About Ankur

With over 17 years of experience in business consulting and advisory services, Ankur has worked with organizations across multiple industries and geographies. He is a Chartered Accountant, a commerce graduate, and holds a postgraduate diploma in Business Administration. Ankur has also earned key certifications, including ISO 31000, CISA (Certified Information Systems Auditor), and CFE (Certified Fraud Examiner). In his current role as Country Director at Dezan Shira & Associates (DSA), India, Ankur is responsible for leading the firm’s operations in India. His expertise lies in advising multinational companies and global businesses investing in emerging markets across Asia - particularly in India. Read More
